landing.eyebrow: Your material. A new way to study.
landing.tagline: The study space your notes deserve.
landing.title: Make your notes worth revisiting.
landing.lead: Turn lecture notes into a course you can read, recall and practise. Built from your material, ready to return to before the exam.
landing.meta1: Free during the beta, with an invite code
landing.mockCaption: 01 / Your notes, now a place to think.

mock.title: Electricity basics
mock.heading: One idea. Put to the test.
mock.sub: Ohm's law links voltage, current and resistance.
mock.question: A 6 V battery drives 2 A through a lamp. What is its resistance?
mock.right: Exactly. R = V / I = 6 V ÷ 2 A.
mock.why: Divide the voltage by the current.

landing.rhythm: Read it. Recall it. Try it. Revisit it.
landing.activeTitle: Less passive reading. More “I've got this.”
landing.activeLead: Move between understanding and practice. Return to the parts that need another look.
landing.card1Title: Close the notes. Find the idea.
landing.card1Question: Why does a longer wire let less current through?
landing.card1Text: Prompt yourself before revealing an answer. Make room for what you actually remember.
landing.card2Note: See the reasoning, not just the result.
landing.card2Text: Test a concept, read the feedback and go back to the source when you need it.
landing.card3Title: Try a rehearsal. Beat the clock.
landing.card3Note: At your pace, when you're ready.
landing.card3Text: Timed practice built from your lecture questions, with a score per lecture.
landing.loopTitle: It remembers what you need next
landing.loop1Text: Picks the lectures to revisit from your own answers.
landing.loop2Text: Parts you mark as difficult come back on schedule.
landing.loop3Text: Answers link to the section of your course they came from.
landing.activeNote: AI-written explanations and practice can contain mistakes. Check them against your own material.
landing.howTitle: Bring the notes. Make them yours.
landing.howLead: You choose the material. You shape the course. Then you find your rhythm.
landing.how1Text: Add a text-readable PDF, TXT or Markdown file. It is read in your browser.
landing.how2Text: Rename or remove suggested lectures until the structure feels right.
landing.how3Text: Your course is online right away. Share the link with classmates; no account needed to study.
landing.privacy1Text: Files are read in your browser and only their text is sent. The text is deleted once the course is published, unless you choose to keep it.
landing.privacy2Text: Anyone with the link can read it. The edit link is private, and you can delete the course at any time.
landing.closingTitle: Your next lecture, worth coming back to.
landing.closingNote: Free during the beta. Ask the person running your study group for an invite code.
landing.footer: Built for thoughtful studying · No account needed to study

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.beta: Beta version for invited students. This page describes what the site does today and will be reviewed before a public launch.

sections.heading: Your files
sections.body: PDF, TXT and Markdown files are read in your browser. Only the extracted text is sent to our server, never the original file.

sections.heading: Writing the course
sections.body: The text is sent to an AI provider, which writes the course from it. The uploaded text is deleted when the course is published, and job records are deleted after 7 days.

sections.heading: Keep my files
sections.body: If you are signed in and switch on Keep my files, the text is kept privately with your course so you can add material or reorganise it later. It is deleted when you switch it off or delete the course or your account.

sections.heading: Your course link
sections.body: A course is stored privately and shown at an unlisted link that search engines are asked not to index. Anyone with the link can read the course. The edit link is private: anyone who has it can change or delete the course.

sections.heading: Studying
sections.body: Your progress, quiz answers, practice exam results and the parts you mark as difficult are stored only in your browser. When you use Ask AI, your question and the course text are sent to the AI provider to write the answer; we do not store them.

sections.heading: Accounts and cookies
sections.body: Signing in with Google is optional. We keep a hashed account id, your name and the list of courses you own. We use only the cookies the site needs: your sign-in, your language, and a marker that this browser already made a guest course.

sections.heading: Deleting
sections.body: You can delete a course from its edit link or from My courses, and delete your account with everything it owns from My courses. Deleted courses stop being served right away.

terms.title: Terms
terms.beta: Beta version for invited students. These terms will be reviewed before a public launch.

sections.heading: The beta
sections.body: Study with AI is free during the beta and open to people with an invite code. Features and limits may change, and the service may pause or stop.

sections.heading: Your material
sections.body: Upload only material you are allowed to use. Share a course link only if you may share the material it was made from. You stay responsible for what you upload and share.

sections.heading: Generated content
sections.body: Courses, quizzes, practice exams and Ask AI answers are written by AI and can contain mistakes. Check them against your own material. Practice scores are feedback for studying, not an assessment.

sections.heading: Removal
sections.body: We may remove a course that breaks these terms or that is reported for copyright or harmful content. Use Report a problem on any course to tell us.
